newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures quiet amid budget uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures quiet amid budget uncertainty.

text.p: UK grain futures, as well as the physical market were stifled by uncertainty, as traders awaited Chancellor Gordon Brown's budget speech.
The grains market was looking for any moves which could affect the value of sterling aginst other European cuurrencies, traders said.
There were just 169 lots of wheat traded on the futures, with January nmost active on 86 lots. It last traded 0.40 stg lower at 88.25 stg.
On barley, just 11 lots changed hands. November was just most active, with 6 lots done. It last traded 0.35 stg lower at 83.90 stg.
Physical market brokers report feed wheat done for delivery to Norfolk/Suffolk in July at 786.00 stg, with spot barley for the same destination at 83.00 stg.
